title: Ray Dalio says to buy ‘a bit’ of Bitcoin amid potential debt crisis
summary: The hedge fund founder with an estimated net worth of $15 billion recommended that investors overweight Bitcoin and gold rather than bonds.

title: Onchain, in court: What happened in crypto legal news this week
summary: The CFTC ordered a trading ban for former Alameda and FTX executives, and US prosecutors opposed a motion from a US soldier accused of profiting from the removal of Nicolas Maduro.

title: Bitcoin seeks support near $77K as BTC, gold near 100-day highs
summary: Bitcoin volatility eased after BTC hit its highest level since mid-May, while gold joined the cryptocurrency in approaching three-month highs.

title: Digital Asset, Paul Ryan foundation target US state benefits with Canton pilot
summary: The RISE program would use the Canton Network to combine and distribute state-administered benefits across three US states beginning in 2027.

title: Bitcoin rally sends crypto stocks soaring as miners, treasury companies jump
summary: Bitcoin’s rally above $79,000 lifted miners and treasury companies, with Canaan, Strive and Metaplanet posting double-digit gains as crypto stocks surged.

title: Crypto Biz: Treasury’s ‘Not-QE’ playbook sends Bitcoin higher
summary: Bitcoin rallied as Treasury bond buybacks fueled the “not-QE” trade, while Metaplanet expanded to the US and Cypherpunk made a $33 million Zcash mining bet.

title: Solana cuts blockchain slot time to 350 milliseconds
summary: Solana reduced its slot time for the first time since genesis as it works toward a 200-millisecond target aimed at reducing network latency.

title: Laser Digital gets Japan’s first crypto exchange approval in 4 years
summary: Nomura-backed Laser Digital Japan received registration to provide domestic liquidity before expanding into institutional crypto trading.

title: Binance says employees questioned in UAE cleared and released
summary: Binance’s employees were cleared and released after providing statements to UAE authorities about third-party fund flows through a company client account, a spokesperson told Cointelegraph.

title: Standard Chartered wavers on $100K Bitcoin year-end call, says it may be ‘too low’
summary: Standard Chartered’s Geoff Kendrick said Bitcoin could move toward its $126,000 all-time high after Oct. 6 as spot Bitcoin ETF inflows recover.
